name: game-editor
description: Work on the Godot 4 project open in your editor, with guards and an approval per plan that says what is lost, and put GameForge sprite sheets, tile sets (a level map becomes its dual-grid tilemap), sound effects and music loops straight into the open scene. Through Godot AI (hi-godot/godot-ai) 4.3.0. Reads never run a @tool script, decided the way Godot decides it. plan_change writes nothing and returns the whole plan with each value now and after and what Godot AI does inside each step; apply_plan runs only the newest plan and reads each step back. A plan that deletes, overwrites, discards unsaved work or runs code it wrote asks a second time with confirm_risky_plan, after a list of what is lost. Play findings carry file:line and evidence, and GameForge's playtest report becomes the same fix steps. A headless play writes res://ge_headless_arm.gd and .tscn, then removes them; project.godot is not left changed.
